title: Assumption (batch 5): Grothendieck-Lefschetz trace formula, trace_globalOperator_eq_sum_trace_stalkFrobenius
statement: Cited assumption of batch 5: upstream PR #1473 (head 495bc3883), WeilConjectures/TraceFormula/Statement.lean, declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.trace_globalOperator_eq_sum_trace_stalkFrobenius. Let l be a prime, k an algebraically closed field of characteristic p prime, p != l, k_0 a finite field with an algebra map k_0 -> k, X_0 a separated k_0-scheme locally of finite type and quasi-compact (f_0:X_0->Spec k_0), and X an object of Over(Spec k), locally of finite type, quasi-compact and separated, with p:X->X_0 such that the square X->X_0, X->Spec k, X_0->Spec k_0, Spec k->Spec k_0 is cartesian (X = X_0 x_{k_0} k), and Phi:X->X over Spec k the model Frobenius: Phi followed by p equals p followed by a #k_0-power Frobenius F_0 of X_0 (IsModelFrobenius) [sk-d-weil, def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write Qlb for the condensed ring Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] and D^b_c(-)[[Qlb]] for bounded constructible Qlb-module objects on the pro-etale site [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Let (K,phi) be a Weil object for Phi, phi: L Phi^* K ~= K (WeilBoundedConstructibleOfEnd l Phi) [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-sfb-module-upper-star], m>=1, and (K,phi_m) its m-th iterate, a Weil object for Phi_m = Phi^m. The global operator F_{c,m} is the Frobenius of RGamma_c(X,(K,phi_m)) = R a_{X!}(K,phi_m), a Weil object for the identity of s=Spec k (weilCompactCohomology, globalOperator) [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek, def-trf-weil-shriek-pushforward, def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism]; for a rational point x:s->X with x Phi_m = x, the local Frobenius F_{x,m} is the Frobenius of the stalk L x^*(K,phi_m) (weilStalk, stalkFrobenius) [def-trf-frobenius-operators]. Assume the set of rational points fixed by Phi_m is finite (Fintype), and that RGamma_c(X,K) and every stalk L x^* K have right duals in the monoidal category D^b_c(s)[[Qlb]]. Then tr(F_{c,m} | RGamma_c(X,K)) = sum over x in X(k) with Phi_m(x)=x of tr(F_{x,m} | K_x), both traces being categorical traces in D^b_c(s)[[Qlb]] with values in End(Qlb_s) [def-trf-categorical-trace].
